div.head: I Cn 2.3
div.ab: And gyf æfre ænig mann heonon forð Godes cyricgrið swa abrece þæt he binnon ciricwagum mannslaga weorþe, þonne sig þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þæra þe Godes freond sig, butan þæt geweorðe þæt he þanon ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece, þæt se cyningc him þurh ðæt feores geunne wiþ fulre bote ge wið God ge wið menn.

And if ever anyone henceforth violates the protection of the church of God by committing homicide within its walls, that crime shall not be atoned for by any payment of compensation, and everyone who is the friend of God shall pursue the miscreant, unless it happen that he escapes from there and reaches so inviolable a sanctuary that the king, because of that, grants him his life, upon condition that he makes full amends both towards God and towards men.

And gyf æfre ænig mann heonon forð Godes cyricgrið swa abrece, þæt he binnon ciricwagum mannslaga weorðe, þonne sig þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þæra þe Godes freond sig, butan þæt geweorðe þæt he þanon ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece, þæt se cyningc him þurh ðæt feores geunne wiþ fulre bote ge wið God ge wið menn.
